Earlier tonight, September 16, 2026, NBC aired another new, LIVE results episode for America’s Got Talent’s current season 21. In this one, we found out the voting results for all the 12 contestants who performed in last nights semifinals, LIVE episode.

To kick off the LIVE results show, host Terry Crews revealed that Olivia Befus and her dog act were still safe and into the finals while Kameron Marshall was eliminated. Terry revealed that aerialist Veronika Goroshkova was still safe, and Daniel Alvarez was eliminated.

Terry revealed that Acro Canine Crew was still safe, and Cesar Dias was eliminated. Korean dance crew Come Here was announced to still be safe. Meanwhile, Luke Taleno was eliminated.

The laser light dance crew were revealed to be safe, and the Young & Strange magic act sadly got eliminated. Finally, Terry revealed that magician Geno Ploeger made it into the finals, and Travis Garland got eliminated.


https://ad.style/

That means The laser light dance crew, Acro Canine Crew, Geno Ploeger, Korean dance crew Come Here, aerialist Veronika Goroshkova and dog act Olivia Befus are the top six, vote-getting contestants who will advance to the finals along with the four other contestants who made it there via the LIVE Golden Buzzer press.


Sadly, Travis Garland, the Young & Strange magic act, Luke Taleno, Cesar Dias, Daniel Alvarez and Kameron Marshall were the six contestants who did not collect enough of America’s votes last night and got eliminated.
